name: CCCC Design & Consulting Group Co., Ltd.
summary: CCCC Design & Consulting Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides engineering design and consulting services in China and internationally. The company surveying services; specialized engineering construction services, including electromechanical and traffic safety engineering, and photovoltaic installation; supervision and engineering testing services; and process services for highway, municipal, water conservancy, energy, and architectural design and consulting. The company was formerly known as Gansu Qilianshan Cement Group Co., Ltd. CCCC Design & Consulting Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Beijing, China.
